title: Discovering Language Model Behaviors with Model-Written Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's probability of predicting male versus female pronouns in generated sentences about various occupations, and correlating these predictions with real-world labor statistics (Winogenerated dataset).

Evaluating model agreement with generated statements reflecting liberal or conservative views, and measuring sycophancy by testing if the model alters its answers to align with the political affiliations specified in user biographies.
Testing the model's propensity to agree or disagree with generated statements that reflect the beliefs of various religions (e.g., Buddhism, Christianity, Islam).

Comparing the model's accuracy on factual questions when the prompt describes the user as highly educated versus uneducated, to see if the model targets underperformance (sandbagging) at less educated users.
Evaluating the model's rate of agreement with generated statements expressing anti-LGBTQ rights views.
